api document of class org.ta4j.core.Posi:
* A {@code Position} is a pair of two {@link Trade trades}. * *

* The exit trade has the complement type of the entry trade, i.e.: *

    *
  • entry == BUY --> exit == SELL *
  • entry == SELL --> exit == BUY *
